fields.label: Shadow number
fields.help: A number from 1 through 32767, unique within this database.

fields.label: Failure handling
fields.help: AUTO removes an unavailable shadow. MANUAL requires administrator intervention when a shadow is unavailable.

fields.label: Conditional shadow
fields.help: Native conditional shadow activation is controlled by Firebird; it is not a scheduled backup.

fields.label: First shadow filename
fields.help: A path on the Firebird server, not on the browser host.

fields.label: First shadow file length
fields.help: Pages, not bytes. Empty leaves the native default.
